product.name: Glass storage jar, 1 liter
product.description: The jar is clear glass and holds one liter.

blocks.text: The label count is the amount you receive.
The tag on Glass storage jar, 1 liter was eleven dollars and forty seven cents.
The amount to be billed is $19.07.
No packing line is added. Extra bulb at one dollar and twenty three cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.

trick.evidence_text: $19.07 has taken the place of the tag.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is $19.07 and the tag was eleven dollars and forty seven cents. Refuse the higher figure.
